xBRIEFInfo.description: F4 - Derive bitmap cache limits from device RAM

plan.title: F4 - Derive bitmap cache limits from device RAM

narratives.Overview: Three in-memory bitmap caches use fixed limits totalling ~288 MB, and one is unbounded by cost.
narratives.Problem:
ProfileImageView.swift:27 sets 192 MB; AppComponents.swift:199 sets 96 MB; and DashboardComponents.swift:181 -- missed by the audit -- sets countLimit = 500 with NO cost limit at all, which is effectively unbounded in bytes since cost varies with image size.

On a 3-4 GB device this invites Jetsam termination, page compression and background-app eviction.
narratives.Action: Scale limits from ProcessInfo.processInfo.physicalMemory, give the third cache a totalCostLimit, and evict in response to memory-pressure notifications.
narratives.Source:

Derived from the Auditor's iOS Performance & Battery Audit; every finding independently re-verified against source at commit 34ba4a0 before specification.

items.title: No cache uses a hardcoded absolute byte limit; all derive from device RAM
Every bitmap cache has a totalCostLimit, with cost as decoded byte size not object count
Caches evict on memory-warning / memory-pressure source
Peak resident memory during sustained scrolling under a stated ceiling on the lowest supported device
No functional regression: images still appear and cache-miss paths still fetch
